$comment: Declarative V1 -> V3 migration mapping. Read by database/scripts/verify-migration.mjs.
V1 and V3 are NOT the same shape: uuid PKs became serial ids (the V1 uuid is preserved
in `uuid` / `meta->>'v1_business_id'`), free-text country became a country_id FK, and
single-DB tables became per-tenant schemas. So the verifier is mapping-aware: every
comparison is expressed here as a pair of SQL expressions, one per side.
RULE (ported from V2's 'default to review, never skip'): every column of `source.table`
must appear either in `columns[].from` or in `dropped[]` with a reason. An unlisted
source column is a MANIFEST ERROR, not a silent pass. A silent skip is data loss.
Entry shape:
name              unique id, also the --table=<name> selector
source.table      the V1 table whose columns must be fully accounted for
source.alias      alias used by the SQL expressions below
source.joins[]    extra FROM clauses (lookups only; their columns are NOT covered here)
source.filter     which V1 rows were in scope for the migration (a declared decision)
target.table      the V3 table; `{{schema}}` is substituted when schemaExpand is set
target.schemaExpand  SQL on the target DB returning schema names; the target query is
repeated per schema and UNION ALL'd (per-tenant tables)
identity          the join key: the same logical V1 key, expressed on each side
columns[]         { name, from, source, target } — `from` names the V1 column(s) the
source expression consumes (null = value is derived, not copied)
dropped[]         { column, reason } — deliberately not migrated
extraTargetRows   what to do about target rows with no source row.
policy 'fail' (default) | 'allow' with an explicit `max` and reason.
Extras are ALWAYS listed in the report, allowed or not.
Agents adding tables: append to `mappings`. The engine is generic — no code change needed.

structural.$comment: Scope of the FK-orphan and sequence-health scans on the target DB. Empty/absent = every non-system schema, which is what a real cutover check wants (public + superadmin + all tenant schemas).

lookups.$comment: Value transforms that need a table from the OTHER database. The verifier runs `query` against `from`, materialises the rows as a VALUES CTE named after the key, and prepends it to every query on `injectInto`. This is how a free-text V1 country is compared against a V3 country_id without either side guessing.

globaly_countries.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (key) key, id FROM (SELECT lower(btrim(name)) AS key, id, 1 AS pri FROM public.countries WHERE name IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT lower(btrim(iso2)), id, 2 FROM public.countries WHERE iso2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT lower(btrim(iso3)), id, 3 FROM public.countries WHERE iso3 IS NOT NULL) s WHERE key <> '' ORDER BY key, id, pri
globaly_countries.$note: Mirrors buildCountryResolver() in recon-v2-users.mjs exactly: name/iso2/iso3 all resolve, lowercased + trimmed, first writer wins (earlier country row, then name > iso2 > iso3).

globaly_issuing_orgs.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (key) lower(btrim(name)) AS key, id FROM public.issuing_organizations WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(name) <> '' ORDER BY key, id
